scope.surface: Default public homepage palette and composition; Google Sans is the shared default UI font
excludes: Custom homepage HTML, Markdown, and URL branches
scope.authority: User-pinned official Google Chrome website and Google Sans; code-led implementation, no approved composition mockup; seed:05acc2a60743c5af
scope.fontCoverage: Self-hosted Google Sans has no CJK glyphs; Arial and system sans fallback remain essential. Explicit application font preferences are preserved.
scope.cssVariableNote: Homepage variables are scoped to .lf-home, so snippets provide literal production-value fallbacks for standalone shadow-DOM rendering.
scope.snippetNote: Static styling previews only. Production reuses shared React components for interactions, routing, accessibility and i18n. The homepage introduces no text-input component or chip primitive; model selectors are shared Tabs.
scope.tonalRampNote: Synthesized OKLCH strips are preview metadata, not production palette additions. DESIGN.md frontmatter owns canonical colors.
scope.responsiveNavigation: At 500px and below, hide the redundant header-toolbar CTA and show its equivalent shared Button registration/dashboard action in the mobile menu via navContent. Hero and closing actions remain available. At 380px and below, the hero heading is 34px.

narrative.overview:
The user selected the official Google Chrome website as the visual reference: a white canvas, near-black Google Sans headings, blue pill actions, and generous pale blue and green product panels. Linfei Technology retains its own name, product mark, gateway content, and single optical-ribbon image. This refresh records the implemented direction; it supersedes the former serif and deep-blue homepage language.

Homepage colors and composition apply only to the default public homepage in `web/src/features/home/components/landing-page.tsx` and `web/src/styles/lftech-home.css`. Google Sans is also the global default UI font through `--font-ui-sans` and `--font-body`; explicit user font preferences remain available. Console and administration palettes, authentication layouts, and custom homepage HTML, Markdown, and URL branches retain their existing systems.
keyCharacteristics: Centered product storytelling, large balanced headings, and blue phrase emphasis.
One subdued ribbon background behind the hero at every breakpoint.
A wide protocol window followed by task exploration and an illustrative usage console.
Shared components, translated copy, keyboard access, dark surfaces, and reduced motion.

rules.name: The Local Palette Rule
rules.body: Keep homepage colors inside `.lf-home`; the console's shared theme remains its own source of truth.

rules.name: The Font Preference Rule
rules.body: Keep Google Sans as the shared default while preserving explicit user font choices and the monospace code face.

rules.name: The Motion Access Rule
rules.body: Reduced motion disables homepage animations and smooth scrolling, and makes header/button transitions effectively immediate; content and controls stay usable without movement.

dos: **Do** follow the user's pinned Chrome reference and Google Sans preference for the default public homepage.
**Do** keep homepage colors local while retaining explicit application font preferences.
**Do** reuse the shared header, footer, buttons, tabs, and original interactive protocol demo.
**Do** retain keyboard access, translated copy, visible focus, dark surfaces, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** display the Linfei Technology brand and preserve New API / QuantumNous / One API attribution and legal notices.
**Do** keep the single ribbon raster behind hero copy on every breakpoint, with its provenance intact.
donts: **Don't** add generated imagery beyond the approved ribbon asset or rasterize interactive content.
**Don't** restore the superseded serif/deep-blue homepage direction or removed tail chapters.
**Don't** present illustrative records, protocol metrics, or catalog availability as measured customer evidence.
**Don't** apply this homepage palette or composition to console themes, custom homepage branches, or authentication layouts.
**Don't** claim that the bundled Google Sans file covers CJK glyphs or remove system fallback behavior.
